test_objective: Check that you cannot create a temporal entity with an empty/invalid json/id

test_cases.name: 007_03_01 Create a temporal entity with missing id
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot create a temporal entity with an invalid @context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'POST'
        Create or Update Temporal Representation of Entity Selecting Content Type: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_representation_id set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-without-id.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '${EMPTY}'
}

test_cases.name: 007_03_02 Create a temporal invalid URI
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot create a temporal entity with an invalid @context
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'POST'
        Create or Update Temporal Representation of Entity Selecting Content Type: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_representation_id set to 'invalidId' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '${EMPTY}'
}
